title: Outpatient
description: Outpatient cards: the doctor refers the patient to the lab and ultrasound, and the doctor’s share (separately for lab, ultrasound and echo) is calculated from payments automatically.
descriptionDoctor: Your outpatients and your share of paid referrals.
pickPatientDescription: Find the patient — then choose the doctor who referred them.

fields.doctorHelp: The share of lab payments sent from this card goes to this doctor.

openDialog.title: {name} — outpatient card
openDialog.hint: Lab and ultrasound referrals are sent from the open card. Payment happens at the cashier as usual.

empty.title: No outpatient cards
empty.description: Patients sent from reception for a doctor visit land here automatically. You can also open a card manually.

commissions.calculation: Calculation: only lab, ultrasound, echo and ozone/hydrocolonotherapy referred from an outpatient card. Share = amount paid at the cashier × percent at referral time (default: lab {lab}%, ultrasound {uzi}%, echo {exo}%, therapy {therapy}%). Discounts and refunds are deducted, cancelled work is excluded. Referrals at 0% are not shown.
commissions.emptyTitle: No outpatient referrals with a doctor share in this period
commissions.emptyDescription: They appear here once a card refers a patient to the lab or ultrasound.

rates.title: Doctor shares (percent)
rates.description: Percent of lab, ultrasound, echo and ozone/hydrocolonotherapy payments credited to the referring doctor of an outpatient card. Each direction is separate.
rates.defaultHelp: Applies to doctors without their own percent. For example, if only some doctors earn on ultrasound, set ultrasound to 0% by default and give those doctors their own percent.
rates.perDoctorHelp: An empty cell uses the default. Changes apply to new referrals only — earlier ones keep their percent.
rates.echoHelp: Checked ultrasound examinations count as echo and earn the echo percent. Unchecked ones are regular ultrasound. Changes affect how new payments are calculated.

detail.doctorLocked: This card has a doctor visit or lab orders — the doctor cannot be changed. Open a new card if needed.
detail.closedHint: The card is closed. Reopen it to send a new referral.
detail.removeHint: Delete it if it was opened by mistake. No referrals were sent from it.
detail.uziPickHint: Pick an ultrasound doctor and select services
detail.addEkgHint: Most cardiology (Abdullayev Arslon) patients also need ECG.
detail.labSent: Lab referral sent to the cashier
detail.noUziDoctors: No ultrasound doctor in this branch.
detail.uziNoShare: This doctor has no ultrasound or echo share.
detail.uziSent: Ultrasound referral sent to the cashier
detail.inpatientWarning: The patient is currently an inpatient ({number}). Tests go to the inpatient account, so an outpatient referral is not possible.
detail.servicesHint: Pick ECG, procedures and other services from the catalogue or enter a name and price by hand. The bill goes to the cashier at once.
